correctness.rationale: Block regeneration gives v=p^2 sum q^{n-1}A_n and sigma^2=p^2 sum q^{n-1}(B_n-2nvA_n+n^2v^2). Each path of at most four steps departs a site at most twice; annealed weights use only mean and variance of omega. Independently re-enumerated exact first four displacement moments and symbolic q^3 series, recovering +12sm^2 and -8s^2 and absence of q term; absolute |A_n|<=n,B_n<=n^2,|v|<=1 bound all n>=5 uniformly by O(q^4). For m=0,s>0 the negative cubic gives strict local maximum; for s(q)->s0 and m(q)^2/q->tau the nonzero limit is 12s0 tau-8s0^2. Equality threshold not decided, nor global monotonicity.
